text: The DJI Matrice 4T incident report found in the collection does not describe a lost link, so it is not used as evidence. On loss of remote signal, if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH, the manual requires the Failsafe RTH to engage automatically. It then starts RTH using Advanced RTH per the RTH settings. If vision/environment conditions are unsuitable, it will brake and hover, then enter Original Route RTH. If the RTH distance is over 50 m, it will orient and fly backward 50 m along the original route before Preset RTH.
